title: ResearchFailureObservation v1
description: A domain-neutral record of the facts observable at inspection time about one run. It stores only directly observed facts: any root-cause or hypothesis field is rejected at the schema layer, because no such property exists and additional properties are forbidden. The anchored run reference is hash-pinned.

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash pinning the exact run record version.

run.description: The run this observation describes. One-directional and hash-pinned; see ADR-0003 decision 3.

model.description: Optional model identifier when a model captured the observation.

observer.description: What captured the observation, bound to a version identifier.

facts.description: Directly observed facts only. Interpretation belongs to research-failure-analysis/v1, never to this record.
